messages:
mia: Quick sync — we're prepping a POC for Jettison-30B (customer: Helix Health). Need variant compatibility check for Dedicated + Private. Main asks: can we run q4f16/q8b on NVLink GPUs and still hit <250ms p50 for 512 tokens? Also KMS for PHI, prefix KV caching behavior, and any quantization fallbacks. Timeline: 2-week POC, ask for cost ballpark. pinging @omar @lucy @raj

omar: Got it. Can you drop sample prompt distribution (seq len percentiles) and expected concurrent requests? Also any hard reqs for deterministic responses? We'll need to pick 1-2 model variants to stage.

mia: sample: 70% <=128 tokens, 25% 129-512, 5% >512. Concurrent: 40 steady, spikes to 120. Deterministic: not strict but do want low variance.

omar: Perfect. For Dedicated: q4f16 should be fine, expect ~180-220ms p50 on an A10G-class node with batch 8 and KV caching. For Private (on-prem with 8xA100 40GB) we'll test kernel selection; need artifact (HF id or s3) and a small config sample.

lucy: @omar quick note: Jettison-30B uses rotary embeddings we optimized; kernel path validated for q4f16 and q8_0, but q8_kn doesn't have fast attention. If they use >512 seq we'll see memory pressure — fallback to chunked KV increases p50. Run locally:

./redwood-infer --model jettison-30b \
  --quant q4f16 --batch 8 --kv-cache on \
  --compile-opts="fast_attention=true,chunk_kv_threshold=1024"

Also GPU memory for q4f16 ~= 22GB with 512 tokens + batch8.

raj: Security: They need PHI support. For Private we can integrate KMS (AWS KMS or customer HSM) — requires network rules + KMS policy. For Hosted/Dedicated, we have SOC2/compliance docs. I'll send the security questionnaire; please confirm data retention TTL and audit log window.

deployer-bot: Deploy job '4176543210-jettison-test' started on staging-dedicated-3 — ETA ~18m :rocket:

mia: Thanks. Pricing: any rough delta for q4f16 vs fp16? POC 2w running sustained ~40 QPS with spikes 120 — rough?

omar: q4f16 reduces memory and throughput cost ~25-35% vs fp16 depending on batch. For a 2-week POC on our staging cluster estimate infra credits ~$3.2k + SE/eng time ~8-12h. If Private, infra cost moves to customer; we bill integration hours.

mia: Ok. Can someone own the validation checklist and coordinate with Helix infra? I'll loop in AE after this thread.

lucy: I'll own validation. Next steps: 1) get model artifact (HF id or s3 link) 2) run compat job on farm (using above deploy) 3) produce perf matrix (p50/p95, mem, token cost). ETA 3 business days after artifact. :white_check_mark:

raj: I'll prep security packet and a KMS playbook (redacted). Send questionnaire responses to me directly.

mia: Great — tagging followups: @omar please schedule a 30m POC kickoff with Helix next Tue. I'll add AE in that invite. :thumbsup:
